title: TaCZ Absorption Hit Sound
description: Replaces TaCZ's hit sound with custom sound when the local player hits a player with absorption hearts.
body:
![logo](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/125e5b7a58e6e24b9544d655aa7f7347cbd9b98e.png)

Client-side TaCZ addon for Minecraft Forge 1.20.1

TaCZ Absorption Hit Sound replaces TaCZ's flesh/head hit sound with `tacz:abs_hit` when the local player hits a player with absorption hearts. ## Notice - Client-side only. - Put `abs_hit.ogg` in `tacz_default_gun/assets/tacz/tacz_sounds/`. - If `abs_hit.ogg` is missing, TaCZ's original hit sound is used. ## Sound File - This mod does not include `abs_hit.ogg`. - Users must provide their own sound file at: `tacz_default_gun/assets/tacz/tacz_sounds/abs_hit.ogg` - After adding or replacing the sound file, restart the game or run `/tacz reload`. ## Authors - Programmer: `Szo9K4` ## Credits - Timeless and Classics Zero ## License - Code and assets: [GNU GPL 3.0](https://www.gnu.org/licenses/gpl-3.0.txt)
